name: AI adoption
description: The adoption of AI is framed as a force that will increase economic concentration rather than fragment markets, creating fewer, larger companies.

edges.quote: Teams with high AI adoption complete 21% more tasks and merge 98% more pull requests, but PR review time increases 91%, based on [data](https://www.faros.ai/blog/ai-software-engineering) from over 10,000 developers across 1,255 teams.
AI will drive greater concentration of value into fewer companies and create the biggest businesses of all time.
AI will do this much more powerfully than legacy software, because it won’t just give humans tools to manage more efficiently, it will do a lot of the work itself.
Automated services companies will get massive, and in doing so, begin to consolidate the fragmented services landscape we see today.
